## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

HyroxTrackerApplication — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker (Hilt `Application` class, to be created), and HyroxWearApplication — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear (same, watch side)

## Trigger

App process start, before any Activity is created — nothing observes it

## Today

Every ViewModel (`RaceListViewModel`, `RaceDetailViewModel`, `ProfileViewModel`,
`PasteResultViewModel`, `PasteErrorViewModel`, `ImportPreviewViewModel` on the
phone; `HomeViewModel`, `MainRacePageViewModel`, `ProjectionViewModel`,
`PreparationViewModel`, `WatchHistoryViewModel`, `EndOfRaceViewModel`,
`ControlViewModel`, `WaitingForPhoneViewModel`, `SensorPermissionViewModel` on
the watch — e.g. `HomeViewModel(raceRepository, profileRepository,
recordedRaceSyncService, connectivityPermissionManager, navigator,
linkStateMonitor, sensorPermissionManager)`) takes its dependencies as plain
constructor parameters. No factory, no `ViewModelProvider.Factory`, no
dependency-injection container and no graph exists anywhere in `:app-phone` or
`:app-wear` to build one. `gradle/libs.versions.toml` carries no Hilt entry in
`[versions]`, `[libraries]` or `[plugins]`; neither `app-phone/build.gradle.kts`
nor `app-wear/build.gradle.kts` applies a Hilt plugin or declares a Hilt
dependency. No `Application` class exists on either module — `app-phone`'s
manifest declares none, `app-wear`'s manifest declares none. `app-phone`'s
`MainActivity` still renders the project-template `Greeting` composable and
never instantiates a ViewModel or hosts any of the screens listed above; no
`MainActivity` exists at all on `:app-wear`, so none of its screens or
ViewModels is ever constructed or displayed.

## Expected

The version catalogue and both application build files declare Hilt (the
plugin, the compiler and the runtime library), as `TECHNICAL_CONVENTIONS.md`
§1 requires. Each application module gets an `Application` class annotated
for Hilt and declared in its manifest, and each screen's ViewModel is
annotated `@HiltViewModel` with `@Inject` on its constructor, resolved through
`hiltViewModel()` at the call site. Each application module gets a
`MainActivity` — `@AndroidEntryPoint`, hosting the root composable and its
navigation graph — declared in its manifest, so every screen and its
ViewModel are actually constructed and reachable at runtime.
